  • Method Details

    • query

      static List<Object[]> query(String sql, Object... parameters) throws SQLException
      Runs a read-only query and returns every row as an array of column values.
      Parameters:
      sql - the SQL, with ? placeholders
      parameters - values for the placeholders, in order
      Returns:
      one array of column values per row
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails or the database cannot be reached

    • runAsync

      static <T> void runAsync(Component owner, JLabel status, String busyText, ReportSupport.Callable<T> work, Consumer<T> onDone)
      Runs database work off the Swing thread, then hands the result back on the Swing thread. Errors are shown in a popup.
      Type Parameters:
      T - type of the result
      Parameters:
      owner - component the error popup is shown over
      status - status label to update, or null
      busyText - text shown in the status label while working
      work - the database work to run in the background
      onDone - receives the result on the Swing thread

    • runAsync

      static <T> void runAsync(Component owner, JLabel status, String busyText, ReportSupport.Callable<T> work, Consumer<T> onDone, Runnable always)
      Same as the other runAsync, plus a step that always runs afterwards, whether the work succeeded or failed (for example, re-enabling a button).
      Type Parameters:
      T - type of the result
      Parameters:
      owner - component the error popup is shown over
      status - status label to update, or null
      busyText - text shown in the status label while working
      work - the database work to run in the background
      onDone - receives the result on the Swing thread
      always - runs after the work finishes, or null
